Overview

Description

Vincent Willem van Gogh was a Dutch Post-Impressionist painter who is among the most famous and influential figures in the history of Western art. In just over a decade he created about 2,100 artworks, including around 860 oil paintings, most of them in the last two years of his life. Wikipedia
Born: March 30, 1853, Zundert, Netherlands
Died: July 29, 1890 (age 37 years), Auvers-sur-Oise, France
Periods: Post-Impressionism, Pointillism, Neo-Impressionism
Siblings: Theo van Gogh, Anna Cornelia van Gogh, Wil van Gogh · See more
Parents: Anna Carbentus van Gogh, Theodorus van Gogh
Height: 5′ 7″
